_doc: Replay set: synthetic code tickets in the Vikunja blob shape, modelled on common ticket patterns (ns/path spelled out, bare name in the title, package path with an incidental tier-B name, no name at all). The repo: line is stripped; declared_repo is what the ticket would have declared.

Task

The landing page uses a green accent on its cards. Make it blue of the same weight.

Where it lives

web/index.html in the compose repo (GitLab: owner/docker).

  • Check text contrast on the cards.
